'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Username:''' Advocate
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
